name: kind-panther
description: A token-tinted isometric tessellation tile with an optional caption and a slow drift that pauses under reduced motion.
purpose: Gives empty states, catalogue cards, and section backdrops a geometric field that stays on semantic tokens in light and dark.
bestFor: catalogue or story frames that need texture
quiet pattern fills on marketing or product surfaces
avoidFor: dense data that needs a plain surface
